input.quote: ARTICLE XXIII NON EXCLUSIVE REMEDY Termination of this Agreement by either party will be a nonexclusive remedy for breach and will be without prejudice to any other right or remedy of such party. NO DAMAGES FOR TERMINATION. NEITHER PARTY WILL BE LIABLE TO THE OTHER FOR DAMAGES OF ANY KIND
input.rationale: No liquidated damages, penalty, early-termination fee or minimum-fee-on-termination is payable by Licensee (our client) anywhere in the Agreement, so the preferred position (no Customer-payable LDs) is already met. The fee provisions (Art. V and the Monthly Notional Volume tiers, p0056-p0070) are purely usage-based per-trade fees plus a $2,500/month support fee (p0086); the only "in no event less than" floor in p0070 is (as drafted) directed at the Licensor and in any event is a true-up to actual recorded trade volume rather than a stipulated damages amount. Termination provisions (Art. IV p0049, Art. XXI p0138) impose no exit payment — Licensor merely retains the right to be paid for trades already performed — and Art. XXIII expressly bars termination damages against either party. Audit cost-shifting on a >5% discrepancy (p0064) is an audit-cost allocation, not a Customer-payable penalty, and falls outside this rule. The rebate/share arrangements (p0075-p0076) run in our favour. No redline required.
